source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: صاحبي عطاني كتاب وقال لازم تقراه.
sentences.en: My friend gave me a book and said I had to read it.
At first, I wasn't very excited.

sentences.ar: بس أول ما بلشت، ما قدرت أوقف.
sentences.en: But as soon as I started, I couldn't stop.

sentences.ar: القصة كانت عن ولد عاش بضيعة صغيرة.
sentences.en: The story was about a boy who lived in a small village.

sentences.ar: كل ليلة، كنت أقرا فصل قبل ما أنام.
sentences.en: Every night, I would read a chapter before sleeping.

sentences.ar: حسيت إني عايش مع الشخصيات بالكتاب.
sentences.en: I felt like I was living with the characters in the book.

sentences.ar: بالآخر، القصة خلصت بشكل ما توقعته.
sentences.en: In the end, the story finished in a way I didn't expect.
I closed the book and sat thinking about it.
I returned the book to my friend and thanked him.

sentences.ar: من يومها، صرت أحب القراية أكتر.
sentences.en: Since that day, I started to love reading more.
